question.text: If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>y</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>z</mi></math> are the roots of the equation <math><mn>2</mn><msup><mrow><mi>t</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><mo>-</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">tan</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>z</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow></mrow><mi>π</mi></mrow></mfenced><msup><mrow><mi>t</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>-</mo><mn>111</mn><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2020</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mtable><mtr><mtd><mi>x</mi></mtd><mtd><mi>y</mi></mtd><mtd><mi>z</mi></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mi>y</mi></mtd><mtd><mi>z</mi></mtd><mtd><mi>x</mi></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mi>z</mi></mtd><mtd><mi>x</mi></mtd><mtd><mi>y</mi></mtd></mtr></mtable></mfenced></math> is equal to (where, <math><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> denotes the greatest integral value less than or equal to <math><mi>x</mi></math>)
